subject: general
question: Aruna bought 8 bananas for Rs. 25 and sold 6 bananas for Rs. 20. What is her profit or loss percentage?
solution:
Given:

CP of 8 bananas = Rs 25

SP of 6 bananas = Rs. 20

Formula used:

Loss = CP – SP

Loss% = Loss/CP × 100

Profit = SP - CP

Profit% = Profit/CP × 100 

Calculation:

CP of 8 bananas = Rs 25

CP of 1 banana = Rs. 25/8 

SP of 6 bananas = Rs. 20

SP of 1 banana = Rs. 20/6 = 10/3

Now,

Profit = SP - CP

⇒ (10/3 - 25/8) = 5/24

Now,

Profit% = Profit/CP × 100 

⇒ [(5/24)/(25/8) × 100]

⇒ (1/3 × 1/5 × 100)

⇒ 20/3% = 6(2)/(3) \%

Her profit percentage is 6(2)/(3) \%.

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
